name: IMAP4
doc:
IMAP4 client class.

Instantiate with: IMAP4([host[, port[, timeout=None]]])

        host - host's name (default: localhost);
        port - port number (default: standard IMAP4 port).
        timeout - socket timeout (default: None)
                  If timeout is not given or is None,
                  the global default socket timeout is used

All IMAP4rev1 commands are supported by methods of the same
name (in lowercase).

All arguments to commands are converted to strings, except for
AUTHENTICATE, and the last argument to APPEND which is passed as
an IMAP4 literal.  If necessary (the string contains any
non-printing characters or white-space and isn't enclosed with
either parentheses or double quotes) each string is quoted.
However, the 'password' argument to the LOGIN command is always
quoted.  If you want to avoid having an argument string quoted
(eg: the 'flags' argument to STORE) then enclose the string in
parentheses (eg: "(\Deleted)").

Each command returns a tuple: (type, [data, ...]) where 'type'
is usually 'OK' or 'NO', and 'data' is either the text from the
tagged response, or untagged results from command. Each 'data'
is either a string, or a tuple. If a tuple, then the first part
is the header of the response, and the second part contains
the data (ie: 'literal' value).

Errors raise the exception class <instance>.error("<reason>").
IMAP4 server errors raise <instance>.abort("<reason>"),
which is a sub-class of 'error'. Mailbox status changes
from READ-WRITE to READ-ONLY raise the exception class
<instance>.readonly("<reason>"), which is a sub-class of 'abort'.

"error" exceptions imply a program error.
"abort" exceptions imply the connection should be reset, and
        the command re-tried.
"readonly" exceptions imply the command should be re-tried.

Note: to use this module, you must read the RFCs pertaining to the
IMAP4 protocol, as the semantics of the arguments to each IMAP4
command are left to the invoker, not to mention the results. Also,
most IMAP servers implement a sub-set of the commands available here.

changed.text: Support for the with statement was added.
The optional timeout parameter was added.

name: abort
doc: IMAP4 server errors cause this exception to be raised. This is a sub-class of IMAP4.error. Note that closing the instance and instantiating a new one will usually allow recovery from this exception.

name: append
doc:
Append message to named mailbox.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.append(mailbox, flags, date_time, message)

        All args except 'message' can be None.

name: authenticate
doc:
Authenticate command - requires response processing.

'mechanism' specifies which authentication mechanism is to
be used - it must appear in <instance>.capabilities in the
form AUTH=<mechanism>.

'authobject' must be a callable object:

        data = authobject(response)

It will be called to process server continuation responses; the
response argument it is passed will be a bytes.  It should return bytes
data that will be base64 encoded and sent to the server.  It should
return None if the client abort response '*' should be sent instead.

changed.text: string usernames and passwords are now encoded to utf-8 instead of being limited to ASCII.

name: capabilities
doc: A tuple of the capabilities advertised by the server, in upper case.

name: check
doc:
Checkpoint mailbox on server.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.check()

name: close
doc:
Close currently selected mailbox.

Deleted messages are removed from writable mailbox.
This is the recommended command before 'LOGOUT'.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.close()

name: copy
doc:
Copy 'message_set' messages onto end of 'new_mailbox'.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.copy(message_set, new_mailbox)

name: create
doc:
Create new mailbox.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.create(mailbox)

name: debug
doc: Integer value to control debugging output. The initialize value is taken from the module variable Debug. Values greater than three trace each command.

name: delete
doc:
Delete old mailbox.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.delete(mailbox)

name: deleteacl
doc:
Delete the ACLs (remove any rights) set for who on mailbox.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.deleteacl(mailbox, who)

name: enable
doc:
Send an RFC5161 enable string to the server.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.enable(capability)

name: error
doc: Exception raised on any errors. The reason for the exception is passed to the constructor as a string.

name: expunge
doc:
Permanently remove deleted items from selected mailbox.

Generates 'EXPUNGE' response for each deleted message.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.expunge()

'data' is list of 'EXPUNGE'd message numbers in order received.

name: fetch
doc:
Fetch (parts of) messages.

(typ, [data, ...]) = <instance>.fetch(message_set, message_parts)

'message_parts' should be a string of selected parts
enclosed in parentheses, eg: "(UID BODY[TEXT])".

'data' are tuples of message part envelope and data.

name: file
doc: Internal BufferedReader associated with the underlying socket. This property is documented for legacy purposes but not part of the public interface. The caller is responsible to ensure that the current file is closed before changing it.

name: getacl
doc:
Get the ACLs for a mailbox.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.getacl(mailbox)

name: getannotation
doc:
(typ, [data]) = <instance>.getannotation(mailbox, entry, attribute)
Retrieve ANNOTATIONs.

name: getquota
doc:
Get the quota root's resource usage and limits.

Part of the IMAP4 QUOTA extension defined in rfc2087.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.getquota(root)

name: getquotaroot
doc:
Get the list of quota roots for the named mailbox.

(typ, [[QUOTAROOT responses...], [QUOTA responses]]) = <instance>.getquotaroot(mailbox)

name: idle
doc:
Return an iterable IDLE context manager producing untagged responses.
If the argument is not None, limit iteration to 'duration' seconds.

with M.idle(duration=29 * 60) as idler:
    for typ, data in idler:
        print(typ, data)

Note: 'duration' requires a socket connection (not IMAP4_stream).

name: burst
doc: Yield a burst of responses no more than interval seconds apart (expressed as an int or float).

name: list
doc:
List mailbox names in directory matching pattern.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.list(directory='', pattern='*')

'data' is list of LIST responses.

name: login
doc:
Identify client using plaintext password.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.login(user, password)

NB: 'password' will be quoted.

name: login_cram_md5
doc:
Force use of CRAM-MD5 authentication.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.login_cram_md5(user, password)

changed.text: An IMAP4.error is raised if MD5 support is not available.

name: logout
doc:
Shutdown connection to server.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.logout()

Returns server 'BYE' response.

changed.text: The method no longer ignores silently arbitrary exceptions.

name: lsub
doc:
List 'subscribed' mailbox names in directory matching pattern.

(typ, [data, ...]) = <instance>.lsub(directory='', pattern='*')

'data' are tuples of message part envelope and data.

name: myrights
doc:
Show my ACLs for a mailbox (i.e. the rights that I have on mailbox).

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.myrights(mailbox)

name: namespace
doc:
Returns IMAP namespaces ala rfc2342

(typ, [data, ...]) = <instance>.namespace()

name: noop
doc:
Send NOOP command.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.noop()

name: open
doc:
Setup connection to remote server on "host:port"
    (default: localhost:standard IMAP4 port).
This connection will be used by the routines:
    read, readline, send, shutdown.

name: partial
doc:
Fetch truncated part of a message.

(typ, [data, ...]) = <instance>.partial(message_num, message_part, start, length)

'data' is tuple of message part envelope and data.

name: PROTOCOL_VERSION
doc: The most recent supported protocol in the CAPABILITY response from the server.

name: proxyauth
doc:
Assume authentication as "user".

Allows an authorised administrator to proxy into any user's
mailbox.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.proxyauth(user)

name: read
doc: Read 'size' bytes from remote.

name: readline
doc: Read line from remote.

name: readonly
doc: This exception is raised when a writable mailbox has its status changed by the server. This is a sub-class of IMAP4.error. Some other client now has write permission, and the mailbox will need to be re-opened to re-obtain write permission.

name: recent
doc:
Return most recent 'RECENT' responses if any exist,
else prompt server for an update using the 'NOOP' command.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.recent()

'data' is None if no new messages,
else list of RECENT responses, most recent last.

name: rename
doc:
Rename old mailbox name to new.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.rename(oldmailbox, newmailbox)

name: response
doc:
Return data for response 'code' if received, or None.

Old value for response 'code' is cleared.

(code, [data]) = <instance>.response(code)

name: search
doc:
Search mailbox for matching messages.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.search(charset, criterion, ...)

'data' is space separated list of matching message numbers.
If UTF8 is enabled, charset MUST be None.

name: select
doc:
Select a mailbox.

Flush all untagged responses.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.select(mailbox='INBOX', readonly=False)

'data' is count of messages in mailbox ('EXISTS' response).

Mandated responses are ('FLAGS', 'EXISTS', 'RECENT', 'UIDVALIDITY'), so
other responses should be obtained via <instance>.response('FLAGS') etc.

name: send
doc: Send data to remote.

name: setacl
doc:
Set a mailbox acl.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.setacl(mailbox, who, what)

name: setannotation
doc:
(typ, [data]) = <instance>.setannotation(mailbox[, entry, attribute]+)
Set ANNOTATIONs.

name: setquota
doc:
Set the quota root's resource limits.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.setquota(root, limits)

name: shutdown
doc: Close I/O established in "open".

name: socket
doc:
Return socket instance used to connect to IMAP4 server.

socket = <instance>.socket()

name: sort
doc:
IMAP4rev1 extension SORT command.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.sort(sort_criteria, charset, search_criteria, ...)

name: starttls
doc: Send a STARTTLS command. The ssl_context argument is optional and should be a ssl.SSLContext object. This will enable encryption on the IMAP connection. Please read Security considerations for best practices.

changed.text: The method now supports hostname check with ssl.SSLContext.check_hostname and Server Name Indication (see ssl.HAS_SNI).

name: status
doc:
Request named status conditions for mailbox.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.status(mailbox, names)

name: store
doc:
Alters flag dispositions for messages in mailbox.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.store(message_set, command, flags)

name: subscribe
doc:
Subscribe to new mailbox.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.subscribe(mailbox)

name: thread
doc:
IMAPrev1 extension THREAD command.

(type, [data]) = <instance>.thread(threading_algorithm, charset, search_criteria, ...)

name: uid
doc:
Execute "command arg ..." with messages identified by UID,
        rather than message number.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.uid(command, arg1, arg2, ...)

Returns response appropriate to 'command'.

name: unselect
doc:
Free server's resources associated with the selected mailbox
and returns the server to the authenticated state.
This command performs the same actions as CLOSE, except
that no messages are permanently removed from the currently
selected mailbox.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.unselect()

name: unsubscribe
doc:
Unsubscribe from old mailbox.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.unsubscribe(mailbox)

name: utf8_enabled
doc: Boolean value that is normally False, but is set to True if an enable() command is successfully issued for the UTF8=ACCEPT capability.

name: xatom
doc:
Allow simple extension commands
        notified by server in CAPABILITY response.

Assumes command is legal in current state.

(typ, [data]) = <instance>.xatom(name, arg, ...)

Returns response appropriate to extension command 'name'.

name: IMAP4_SSL
doc:
IMAP4 client class over SSL connection

Instantiate with: IMAP4_SSL([host[, port[, ssl_context[, timeout=None]]]])

        host - host's name (default: localhost);
        port - port number (default: standard IMAP4 SSL port);
        ssl_context - a SSLContext object that contains your certificate chain
                      and private key (default: None)
        timeout - socket timeout (default: None) If timeout is not given or is None,
                  the global default socket timeout is used

for more documentation see the docstring of the parent class IMAP4.

changed.text: The class now supports hostname check with ssl.SSLContext.check_hostname and Server Name Indication (see ssl.HAS_SNI).
The optional timeout parameter was added.
The deprecated keyfile and certfile parameters have been removed.

name: IMAP4_stream
doc:
IMAP4 client class over a stream

Instantiate with: IMAP4_stream(command)

        "command" - a string that can be passed to subprocess.Popen()

for more documentation see the docstring of the parent class IMAP4.

name: Int2AP
doc: Convert integer to A-P string representation.

name: Internaldate2tuple
doc:
Parse an IMAP4 INTERNALDATE string.

Return corresponding local time.  The return value is a
time.struct_time tuple or None if the string has wrong format.

name: ParseFlags
doc: Convert IMAP4 flags response to python tuple.

name: Time2Internaldate
doc:
Convert date_time to IMAP4 INTERNALDATE representation.

Return string in form: '"DD-Mmm-YYYY HH:MM:SS +HHMM"'.  The
date_time argument can be a number (int or float) representing
seconds since epoch (as returned by time.time()), a 9-tuple
representing local time, an instance of time.struct_time (as
returned by time.localtime()), an aware datetime instance or a
double-quoted string.  In the last case, it is assumed to already
be in the correct format.
